units.title: Identification and Testing of Electronics components
topics: 1.1. Passive Electronic Components: All category of fixed and variable Resistor, Inductor, Capacitor, Rheostat, Resistor Arrays.

1.2. Active/ Semiconductor components: Diode, Zener Diode, Varactor diode, LED, Bridge rectifier, Photo diode, BJT, Photo transistor, FET, LDR, Solar cell, Photocell, Opto-coupler, DIAC, TRIAC, laser, 7- segment Display, NTC Thermistor, SMD Components.

1.3. Miscellaneous Components AC Source: Single phase, and Three Phase. DC Source: All kind DC Battery, and Variable DC Source. Transformer: Step down transformer, Auto transformer, Pulse transformer, Inter mediate Frequency Transformer (IFT) Fuse: AC fuse, DC fuse, Glass, Ceramic fuse, Metal Oxide Varistor (MOV) fuse, High Rupturing Capacity (HRC)fuse, Switch fuse, Resettable/poly fuse, Automotive fuse, SMD fuse.

1.4. Interpretation of Manufacturer’s Datasheet of: - Diodes IN4001 to 07, IN4148; 2N5402, 2N5408, BY127 - Zener Diode, Photo diode, LED, Varactor diode, Seven segment LED - Transistors BC107, BC177, BC547/548, SL100, SK100, AC127/128, BF194, TIP122, Photo transistor - voltage regulator IC78XX, 79XX, LM317 - Packages of various SMD components: Resistor, Capacitor, Inductor, Diode-LL4148, SM4007, Chip transistor, Chip Darlington transistor, Bridge rectifier.
1.5. Drawing: Symbols and electronics Circuits on drawing sheets. Electronics Workshop for ICT Course Code: 1323201
uos: 1.a. Demonstrate and Identify terminals of different Electronics components
1.b. Read and interpret Specifications, parameter values and ratings of electronic components.
1.c. Interpretation of Data sheets.
1.d. Drawing symbols of electronic components.

units.title: Testing of different Electronics components using appropriate tools and measuring
topics: 2.1. Measuring Instruments: Analog Multi meter, wattmeter, Digital Multi meter, LCR-Q meter, CRO, DSO, Function Generator, Digital Field strength meter, Frequency counter, Portable Digital Clamp ON meter, Electric tester, Series test lamp, Electronic Continuity tester, Non-contact AC voltage tester, Digital Voltage tester
2.2. Use of electronics Application Software: Selection, connection of electronic components, design electronic circuit and simulation of circuit using open-source application
uos: 2.a. Test different electronic component’s parameters
2.b. Use of measuring instruments
2.c. Use of various Workshop Tools.

units.title: Working and Applications of different types of cables, connectors and switches
topics: 3.1. Cables: Multi core, multi strand, Co axial, Twisted pair, Optical fiber cable, Flat ribbon cable, printer cable, Power cable, AV cable, flexible wires

3.2. Connectors BNC, DC Connector, Screw terminal, Banana Connector, DIN connector, JST connector, Jack pin, XLR Pin for microphone, RJ-45, RJ-11, connectors, Insulation Displacement Connector (IDC), RS232, HDMI, USB 2.0,USB 3.0,Micro USB, Type C , OTG connector, FRC, Berg strip 2.3

3.3. Switches SPST, SPDT, DPDT, Membrane, Push button with latch, Toggle, Rotary, Tactile, Micro switch, Limit switch, DIP switch, Thumb wheel switch, Level switch, Touch switch, Thermal fuse (Bi metallic strip) Relay, Static switches, Proximity switch, Hall effect switch, MCB, ELCB
uos: 3.a. Types of wires/cables, Sizes and Installation
3.b. Connectors and their specifications.
3.c. Different types of switches and their applications.

units.title: Identifying Application specific Sensors and Actuators
topics: 4.1. Sensors Identify and test the working of different type of sensors used in different applications: Temperature Sensor (Thermistor, Thermocouple), Humidity Sensor, Gas Sensors, Light Sensors (LDR, Photodiode, Phototransistor), Piezo pressure sensors, Strain gauge, Color Sensor, Capacitive Touch Sensors, Magnetic Hall-effect sensor, IR Proximity Sensor, PIR Motion Sensor, IR based object range measurement sensor HC-SR04, Electronics Workshop for ICT Course Code: 1323201

4.2. Actuators Identify and test the working of different type of Actuators used in different applications: DC Motors, AC motors, Servo Motors, Stepper Motors, Relays, SSR, solenoid valves, Piezoelectric actuators, LEDs (different color, RGB), alphanumeric displays, Speakers, buzzers.
uos: 4.a. Identify sensors and actuators for various applications.
4.b. describe input and output of different sensors and actuators.
4.c. Test sensors and actuators for various applications. vibration sensors, Microphone, Biometric Sensors (Figure print, face recognition).

units.title: Soldering – de-soldering practices and types of PCBs:
topics: 5.1. Use of soldering and disordering tools and practice:
1. Introduction
2. The Soldering Iron: Temperature controller iron, non Temperature controller iron.
3. The Solder: Tin-lead, lead-free (RoHS), Rosin core (60/40 Sn/Pb and 63/37 Sn/Pb), Silver, Acid-core, various diameter of soldering wire.
4. use of soldering iron stand.
5. use of de-soldering Pump and de-soldering wick
6. Need of soldering flux.
7. Use of soldering tip cleaner, solder-stand, flat cutter, Wire Stripper, Nose Plier, helping hand, single core connecting wire.
8. steps to achieve zero defect soldering.
9. Safety precautions and What to do and What not to do when soldering.
5.2. Types of PCBs:
1. Differentiate GP board and PCB and their specific uses
2. Various types of PCB based on printing layers: Single-Sided PCBs, Double-Sided PCBs, Multilayer PCBs
4. Various types of PCBs based on material used: FR4 epoxy, Teflon, polyimide, glass.
5.3. Types of component packages: Identify various Packages of electronic components: DIP, TSSOP, QFP, QFN, BGA
uos: 5.a. Use deferent tools for soldering and de- soldering.
5.b. Use deferent materials for soldering and de- soldering.
5.c. Perform different soldering and de- soldering steps on GP board.
5.d. Inspect the soldering joints and its defects.
5.e. learn safety and precautions during soldering and de- soldering.
5.f. Describe different types of PCBs and their uses.
5.g. Identify different packages of electronic components.
